title: CDS Exam Guide: Complete Roadmap for IMA, OTA, INA & AFA
summary: Everything you need to know about the UPSC Combined Defence Services (CDS) exam: eligibility for men and women, written paper structure, SSB interview, and academy training.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction

The Combined Defence Services (CDS) Examination is conducted twice every year by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) to commission young graduate men and women as officers in the Indian Armed Forces. Selected cadets receive world-class military and leadership training at the **Indian Military Academy (IMA), Officers Training Academy (OTA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), or Air Force Academy (AFA)**, entering service with the rank of Lieutenant, Sub-Lieutenant, or Flying Officer.

## Academy Wise Eligibility Criteria

| Academy | Branch / Service | Gender Eligibility | Educational Qualification |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Indian Military Academy (IMA)** | Indian Army (Permanent Commission) | Unmarried Men | Degree from a recognized University or equivalent |
| **Officers Training Academy (OTA)** | Indian Army (Short Service Commission) | Men & Women (Unmarried / Issueless Widows) | Degree from a recognized University or equivalent |
| **Indian Naval Academy (INA)** | Indian Navy (Permanent Commission) | Unmarried Men | Degree in Engineering from a recognized University / Institution |
| **Air Force Academy (AFA)** | Indian Air Force (Flying Branch) | Unmarried Men | Degree of a recognized University (with Physics & Maths at 10+2 level) OR Bachelor of Engineering |

## Age Limit & Marital Status

| Academy | Permissible Age Limit | Marital Status Criteria |
|---|---|---|
| **IMA** | 19 - 24 Years | Unmarried Only |
| **INA** | 19 - 24 Years | Unmarried Only |
| **AFA** | 20 - 24 Years (Up to 26 years with valid Commercial Pilot Licence) | Unmarried Only |
| **OTA (Men & Women)** | 19 - 25 Years | Unmarried (or issueless widows / divorcees for women) |

## Written Examination Pattern

### For IMA, INA, and Air Force Academy (3 Papers)
| Paper / Subject | Duration | Maximum Marks | Negative Marking |
|---|---|---|---|
| **English** | 2 Hours | 100 Marks | 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer |
| **General Knowledge** | 2 Hours | 100 Marks | 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer |
| **Elementary Mathematics** | 2 Hours | 100 Marks | 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer |
| **Grand Total** | **6 Hours** | **300 Marks** | **Sectional Cutoff: Minimum 20% per subject** |

### For Officers Training Academy (OTA - 2 Papers, No Mathematics)
| Paper / Subject | Duration | Maximum Marks | Negative Marking |
|---|---|---|---|
| **English** | 2 Hours | 100 Marks | 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer |
| **General Knowledge** | 2 Hours | 100 Marks | 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer |
| **Grand Total** | **4 Hours** | **200 Marks** | **Sectional Cutoff: Minimum 20% per subject** |

## SSB Interview Structure (Stage I & II)

| Stage | Testing Technique | Key Activities Evaluated |
|---|---|---|
| **Stage I (Day 1)** | Screening Test | Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) test + Picture Perception & Discussion Test (PPDT). Only shortlisted candidates proceed. |
| **Stage II (Day 2-5)** | Psychological Testing | Thematic Apperception Test (TAT), Word Association Test (WAT), Situation Reaction Test (SRT), Self Description (SD). |
| **Group Testing (GTO)** | Ground Tasks | Group Discussion (GD), Group Planning Exercise (GPE), Progressive Group Task (PGT), Half Group Task (HGT), Individual Obstacles, Command Task. |
| **Interview & Conference** | Personal Evaluation | 45-minute interview with Interviewing Officer followed by Final Board Conference and Medical Board. |

## 4-Phase CDS Preparation Strategy

| Phase | Targeted Action Plan |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1: English Language Mastery** | English is the highest-scoring section in CDS. Focus heavily on reading comprehension, spotting errors, sentence rearrangement (S1-S6), idioms, and synonyms/antonyms. Target 70+ marks out of 100 in English. |
| **Phase 2: General Knowledge & Defense Current Affairs** | Prioritize NCERT Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology - gives 30-35 easy questions). Study Indian Polity, Modern History, and Geography. Revise defense exercises, missile tests, and geopolitical developments. |
| **Phase 3: Elementary Mathematics (For IMA/INA/AFA)** | Master Class 9 and 10 geometry, trigonometry, mensuration, and arithmetic. These 4 topics constitute over 65% of the CDS maths paper. Solve past 10 years UPSC question papers. |
| **Phase 4: Physical Fitness & OLQ Development** | Run 3 to 5 km daily, practice pull-ups, push-ups, and outdoor sports. Read daily editorials to form balanced viewpoints for Group Discussions and Personal Interviews during the SSB. |

Commissioning through CDS transforms graduates into leaders who command troops and defend the nation. Begin your physical training and GK preparation in tandem to guarantee success from written through SSB.
